intro: Kirge Sternhorn is a tauren stationed in the rugged frontier of the Barrens. Serving as a steady presence for travelers journeying across central Kalimdor, he directs fledgling Horde adventurers northward toward the vital outpost of the Crossroads.

p: The vast, sun-baked plains of the Barrens are daunting for newly arrived wanderers, and Kirge Sternhorn stands as a helpful guide along their path. Stationed south of the central trails, he watches over travelers moving between the southern camps and the heart of Kalimdor. Understanding the dangers of marauding quilboar and fierce predators roaming the savanna, Kirge ensures that young adventurers find their footing and seek out the greater Horde presence gathering to the north.
